name: conflict-resolution-email
description:
Writes professional emails that address workplace conflicts, disagreements,
and difficult conversations with empathy, clarity, and constructive framing
to reach resolution. Use when the user needs to address a disagreement,
miscommunication, or interpersonal issue via email. Do NOT use for formal
complaints (use `business-letter`), performance issues (use `pip-writing`),
or rejection communications (use `rejection-letter`).
